messages.subject: Fieldshape qgis
parts:
Hello!

Today I wanted to ask you about the fieldshape function in qgis, I have a problem only when I put values to x and y.

Basically, when I make my plots, I have no problem using the function without putting measurements or even putting a buffer, but when I want to make a plot of specific measurements and fill in x and y it leaves me with the plots diagonally (I noticed that they are always like pointing north). In the image I put so that they can be seen well that in the normal combination of buffer or without putting anything the plots are well ordered, but when I put the value of x and y they appear that way, for now the solution is to rotate one by one.

Thank you for your patience! We're pleased to inform you that the issue with the plotsize function (x and y buffer) in fieldshape_render() has been resolved. The FIELDimageR Team has implemented the necessary fixes, and you should now be able to use the function without any issues. Your feedback helped us improve, and we appreciate your contribution to making FIELDimageR better for everyone. If you encounter any further issues or have additional feedback, please don't hesitate to let us know. Thanks again for your support!
